ei.title: The Power of COLORS in Movies
ei.subject: 영어2

fullPassage: Colors are an important aspect of films. They look visually attractive and can be used to convey various emotions and messages to the audience. Film directors carefully select colors like bright yellow to bring a sense of hope, calm blue for peace, and intense red for violence. These color choices are not random; they are intentionally made to impact your experience while you watch the film, even if you don’t consciously notice them. Below are several outstanding examples of how skillfully film directors can use color to add richness to the story and evoke specific emotions from the audience. Like the saying “A picture is worth a thousand words,” colors get a film’s message across more strongly than words. A good example is the red coat in a movie about the true story of a German businessman who saved thousands of Jews from the Nazis during World War II. While the movie was mostly in black and white, the director chose one particular thing to add color to. It was the red coat of a single lost girl, alone in a crowd of frightened Jews. As such, it was the strong contrast of colors that enabled the director to powerfully symbolize the brutality of the Nazis. The young girl represents innocence while also representing the violence of the Nazis. So, what happened to this young girl? The movie never tells us for sure, but later in the film we see a dead girl in a red coat being loaded into a cart. Colors strengthen the emotions of viewers due to their ability to evoke strong psychological reactions. An excellent example can be found in an animated film where an ordinary citizen becomes a superhero to defeat a villain. At the beginning of the film, the male character, who was once a superhero but had to return to living an ordinary life, is surrounded by dull colors and gray tones. He is working as if he were an ordinary person, hiding his true power. However, when he returns to work as a superhero, the film fills up with bold reds, yellows, and blues. These colors represent power and happiness. This shift reflects his emotional development, and viewers can grasp his mood without words. Through such a process, colors impact the emotional experience of the audience. Colors help audiences grasp the connections between characters, places, and important objects in films, making complex stories easier to understand. There is a film from the 1930s that shows the adventures of a girl attempting to return home after being swept away in a flash by a tornado to a land of magic. The director uses colors to effectively communicate with the audience. The girl’s life in a boring village is shown in black and white, and the world of magic is expressed in various colors in the movie. With such color differences, the audience can distinguish which world the events take place in. Audiences watching this film are immersed in the world of magic as if they were the girl when watching the scenes that turn to color in a flash. Film directors capture the changes in their characters’ lives through changes in color. Another film from the 1990s follows the dramatic experience of a man with scissor hands who comes down to a town to live with ordinary folks. He always wears black, and the castle where he used to live was a gray and gloomy place. However, in the town where he came to live with his lover, each house is painted differently, and the people wear colorful clothes. At first, he is welcomed by the people in town, but as he becomes misunderstood and disliked, the film’s colors gradually become darker. Eventually, he returns to his castle, but he fills his garden with green grass and beautiful, blooming flowers. Moreover, ice powder from his ice sculpture blows in the wind like snow. With such changes, the director shows the audience that his life has become much happier. Film directors choose colors to give us the best possible experience. When watching movies, consider why specific colors are used in a scene. You may not know the answer, but your understanding of the film will be deeper.

questions.passage: Colors are an important aspect of films. They look visually attractive and can be used to (A)[convey / conceal] various emotions and messages to the audience. Film directors carefully select colors like bright yellow to bring a sense of hope, calm blue for peace, and intense red for violence. These color choices are not random; they are (B)[accidentally / intentionally] made to impact your experience while you watch the film, even if you don’t consciously notice them. Below are several outstanding examples of how skillfully film directors can use color to add (C)[richness / dullness] to the story and evoke specific emotions from the audience. Like the saying “A picture is worth a thousand words,” colors get a film’s message across more strongly than words.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① convey(전달하다)+intentionally(의도적으로)+richness(풍성함): 색상이 감정과 메시지를 '전달'하고, 색상 선택이 '의도적으로' 이루어지며, 색으로 이야기에 '풍성함'을 더한다는 문맥에 모두 맞음 ← 정답
❌ ② conceal(숨기다)은 '감정과 메시지를 전달한다'는 흐름과 정반대
❌ ③ accidentally(우연히)는 'not random(무작위가 아니다)'이라는 앞 내용과 반대
❌ ④ dullness(따분함)는 이야기에 '풍성함'을 더한다는 문맥과 반대
det.tip: convey=전달하다, intentionally=의도적으로, richness=풍성함

questions.passage: Like the saying “A picture is worth a thousand words,” colors get a film’s message across more (A)[strongly / weakly] than words. A good example is the red coat in a movie about the true story of a German businessman who saved thousands of Jews from the Nazis during World War II. While the movie was mostly in black and white, the director chose one particular thing to add color to. It was the red coat of a single lost girl, alone in a crowd of frightened Jews. As such, it was the strong (B)[similarity / contrast] of colors that enabled the director to powerfully symbolize the brutality of the Nazis. The young girl represents (C)[innocence / guilt] while also representing the violence of the Nazis. So, what happened to this young girl?
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① weakly(약하게)는 메시지를 말보다 '더 강하게' 전달한다는 문맥과 반대
✅ ② strongly(강하게)+contrast(대비)+innocence(순수함): 색상이 메시지를 말보다 '강하게' 전달하고, 강렬한 색상의 '대비'가 상징을 가능하게 하며, 어린 소녀가 '순수함'을 상징한다는 문맥에 맞음 ← 정답
❌ ③ similarity(유사함)는 강렬한 '대비'를 말하는 흐름과 반대
❌ ④ guilt(죄책감)는 소녀가 '순수함'을 상징한다는 문맥과 반대
det.tip: strongly=강하게, contrast=대비, innocence=순수함

det.analysis:
❌ ① assist(돕다)는 악당을 '물리치기' 위해 슈퍼히어로가 된다는 문맥과 반대
❌ ② bright(밝은)는 평범한 삶에서 '칙칙한' 색과 회색 톤에 둘러싸였다는 흐름과 반대
✅ ③ defeat(물리치다)+dull(칙칙한)+bold(강렬한): 악당을 '물리치는' 슈퍼히어로, 평범한 삶의 '칙칙한' 색, 다시 활동할 때 '강렬한' 빨강·노랑·파랑이라는 문맥에 맞음 ← 정답
❌ ④ pale(옅은)은 힘과 행복을 상징하는 '강렬한' 색이라는 문맥과 반대

questions.passage: Colors help audiences grasp the connections between characters, places, and important objects in films, making complex stories ①<u>easier</u> to understand. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ confuse → distinguish: 색의 차이 덕분에 관객이 어느 세계인지 '구분한다(distinguish)'
det.analysis:
✅ ① easier: 'making complex stories easier to understand'(복잡한 이야기를 더 쉽게 이해하도록)라는 문맥에 적절
✅ ② attempting: 'a girl attempting to return home'(집으로 돌아가려고 시도하는 소녀)이라는 문맥에 적절
✅ ③ expressed: 'the world of magic is expressed in various colors'(마법의 세계가 다양한 색으로 표현되는)라는 문맥에 적절
❌ ④ confuse(혼동하다) → distinguish(구분하다): 'the audience can distinguish which world the events take place in'에서 색의 차이로 관객이 어느 세계에서 일이 일어나는지 '구분'한다는 뜻이므로 distinguish가 맞다. confuse는 정반대 ← 정답

det.tip: he is welcomed by the people(사람들에게 환영받는) ↔ rejected(거부당하는). invited·greeted·praised는 모두 비슷한 긍정 의미라 오답

questions.passage:
(A) In the film, the red coat <u>represents</u> the innocence of a lost child. It stands for something far deeper than its bright color.
(B) Two experienced lawyers <u>represent</u> the large company whenever it goes to court. They speak and act on behalf of their client.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B) 두 문장에서 밑줄 친 represents의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② (A) the red coat represents the innocence는 붉은 외투가 순수함을 '상징한다·나타낸다'는 뜻이고, (B) lawyers represent the company는 변호사가 회사를 '대표한다·대변한다'는 뜻임 ← 정답
❌ ① (A)는 '대표하다'가 아니라 순수함을 상징함
❌ ③ (B)는 '발표하다'가 아니라 회사를 대표함
❌ ④ (A)는 '제시하다'가 아니라 상징함
det.tip: represent: (A) 상징하다·나타내다 / (B) 대표하다·대변하다

questions.stem:
다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"a bad or evil character in a story or film who harms others"

det.analysis:
❌ ① hero(영웅): 선한 주인공으로 악당과 반대
❌ ② director(감독): 영화를 만드는 사람
❌ ③ viewer(관객): 영화를 보는 사람
✅ ④ villain(악당): 이야기나 영화에서 남을 해치는 나쁘거나 악한 인물 ← 정답
det.tip: becomes a superhero to defeat a villain = 악당을 물리치려고 → villain = 악당

questions.passage: He is working as if he __________ (be) an ordinary person, hiding his true power. However, when he returns to work as a superhero, the film fills up with bold reds, yellows, and blues.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: be(동사 원형) → were: 'as if + 주어 + 과거동사'는 '마치 ~인 것처럼'이라는 가정법 표현이다. 실제로는 평범한 사람이 아니지만 '마치 평범한 사람인 것처럼' 일한다는 뜻이므로 가정법 과거를 써야 한다. 가정법에서 be동사는 주어와 상관없이 were로 쓰므로 be를 were로 바꾼다.
det.tip: as if + 주어 + were: 마치 ~인 것처럼 (가정법 과거)

questions.passage: Colors help audiences grasp the connections between characters, places, and important objects in films, __________ (make) complex stories easier to understand. There is a film from the 1930s that shows the adventures of a girl returning home.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.analysis: make(동사 원형) → making: 앞 문장 전체가 원인이고 뒤가 결과인 '그래서 ~하게 만들면서'라는 분사구문 자리다. 분사구문은 동사를 -ing 형태로 쓰므로 make를 making으로 바꿔야 한다. 'and it makes complex stories easier(그래서 복잡한 이야기를 더 쉽게 만든다)'를 분사구문으로 줄인 것이다.
det.tip: 분사구문: ~, making complex stories easier(그래서 복잡한 이야기를 더 쉽게 만들면서)

questions.passage: A good example is the red coat in a movie about the true story of a German businessman who saved thousands of Jews from the Nazis during World War II. While the movie was mostly in __________, the director chose one particular thing to add color to. It was the red coat of a single lost girl, alone in a crowd of frightened Jews. As such, it was the strong contrast of colors that enabled the director to powerfully symbolize the brutality of the Nazis. The young girl represents innocence while also representing the violence of the Nazis. So, what happened to this young girl?
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① black and white(흑백): 영화가 대부분 '흑백'이었는데 감독이 색을 더할 한 가지(붉은 외투)를 선택했다는 대조 문맥에 적절 ← 정답
❌ ② bright colors(밝은 색): 뒤에서 '색을 더했다'고 하므로 원래는 색이 없는 흑백이어야 하여 어색함
❌ ③ slow motion(느린 화면): 색과 흑백의 대비를 말하는 문맥과 무관
❌ ④ total silence(완전한 침묵): 소리가 아니라 색에 관한 문맥이라 맞지 않음
det.tip: mostly in black and white ~ chose one particular thing to add color to: 대부분 흑백인데 색을 더할 한 가지를 선택

questions.passage: He always wears black, and the castle where he used to live was a gray and gloomy place. However, in the town where he came to live with his lover, each house is painted differently, and the people wear colorful clothes. At first, he is welcomed by the people in town, but as he becomes misunderstood and disliked, the film’s colors gradually become darker. Eventually, he returns to his castle, but he fills his garden with green grass and beautiful, blooming flowers. Moreover, ice powder from his ice sculpture blows in the wind like snow. With such changes, the director shows the audience that his life has become __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① far more boring(훨씬 더 지루한): 정원을 꽃으로 채우는 밝은 변화와 반대
✅ ② much happier(훨씬 더 행복한): 성으로 돌아가 정원을 초록 풀과 활짝 핀 꽃으로 채우고 얼음 가루가 눈처럼 날리는 변화를 통해 그의 삶이 '훨씬 더 행복해졌음'을 보여준다는 문맥에 적절 ← 정답
❌ ③ very dangerous(매우 위험한): 긍정적 변화와 반대
❌ ④ completely empty(완전히 텅 빈): 정원을 꽃으로 '채운다'는 앞 내용과 반대
det.tip: fills his garden with green grass and beautiful, blooming flowers ~ his life has become much happier: 꽃으로 가득 찬 변화 → 훨씬 행복해짐
